generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenderer should upload the Caste Certificate in the Prescribed Format issued by GOK which is Mandatory. The Tenderer Belonging to Schedule Caste or Schedule Tribe shall be Domicile of the State of Karnataka for more than 10 years.If the Contractor is a Firm,then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to SC or ST as the case may be
Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc. as per KTPP act and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in e-procurement portal and the rates should not be disclosed.
ALL THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS ARE AS PER BID DOCUMENT
Bid Capacity has to be uploaded

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor for at least any construction work to extent of 25% of cost of the work Rs.18.74 Lakhs with GST

The tenderer should have executed in any one year the minimum quantites of similar work and completed in all respects including commissioning in a continous 12 months of Providing and laying of 230mm dia and above GSW pipeline for a length of 1060Rmt

The tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least ONE financial years a MINIMUM financial turnover of rupees not less than the Rs.74.95 lakhs. Turnover, Profit & Loss account, Balance sheet statement certified / audited by a Chartered Accountant along with UDIN No. to be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Assessed available tender capacity (AN5)-B should be greater than Rs.74.95 lakhs Where, A is Maximum value of Civil Engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years taking into account the completed as well as works in progress N is Number of years B is Value of on-going works.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.22.48 lakhs (credit lines/letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc.).
Tenderer must be Registered in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc. as per KTPP act and shall furnish valid registration certificate which is in currency
